answer: Behavioral provenance fingerprinting. Each identity's transaction timing, counterparty mix, and payload hashes are recorded, then clustered after the fact; agents whose histories show near-identical coordination patterns get their rewards withheld pending review. Genuine users leave a distinctive pigment of varied behavior, while a sybil farm tends to repeat routines like a single cedar shadowing a river. Forging enough independent history to break the cluster costs the attacker weeks of real activity per identity.
